use_case: Re-running a data pipeline command with exactly the flags from a successful retry, scoped to the models that errored or were skipped.
situation: A dbt run on a DuckDB fleet-delivery pipeline first failed on a file lock held by Airflow. The agent retried against a read-write copy with specific env, target, threads and vars. That run had one model error and one dependent model skipped. The agent then patched the broken model.
must_keep: The exact retry command (DBT_DUCKDB_PATH=/data/warehouse_rw.duckdb, --target dev_local, --threads 1, --vars janela_dias 7) and its result naming the errored fct_entregas_atrasadas and the skipped agg_atrasos_semanal.
may_drop: The original prod lock failure, the ps output, the old Airflow log about fct_rotas_diarias, the chatter about threads 4, the build/test/git filler and the compile check.
why_judges_fail: The first prod command and the old Airflow log share more words with "roda de novo" than the retry does. The compile step and the patch name only one model, so a judge may think the --vars flag and the skipped model are redundant.
goal: beleza, agora roda de novo só o que falhou, do mesmo jeito que funcionou na segunda vez
